say:1:1910842001:1.text: Sister, you're here! Why so early this time? I haven't fully awakened yet...

say:1:1910842001:1.male: Sister, you're here! Why so early this time? I haven't fully awakened yet...
say:1:1910842001:1.female: Sister, you're here! Why so early this time? I haven't fully awakened yet...

say:2:1910842002:1.text: Is this your new avatar? No, that's not it...
say:2:1910842002:1.male: Is this your new avatar? No, that's not it...
say:2:1910842002:1.female: Is this your new avatar? No, that's not it...

say:3:1910842003:1.text: You are not Dura, and yet you carry her scent.

choice_prompt:4:1910842003.female: You are not Dura, and yet you carry her scent.

say:5:1910842004:1.text: Merlin was the mortal name my mischievous little sister gave herself.
say:5:1910842004:1.source_cn: 梅林，我那顽皮妹妹给自己的凡人名字。
say:5:1910842004:1.male: Merlin was the mortal name my mischievous little sister gave herself.
say:5:1910842004:1.female: Merlin was the mortal name my mischievous little sister gave herself.

say:6:1910842005:1.text: I see... You're the one <style="highlight">she chose</style>. Her long experiment has finally borne fruit.
say:6:1910842005:1.male: I see... You're the one <style="highlight">she chose</style>. Her long experiment has finally borne fruit.
say:6:1910842005:1.female: I see... You're the one <style="highlight">she chose</style>. Her long experiment has finally borne fruit.

say:7:1910842006:1.text: Your face is disguised too, but I can see through such things. The bright eyes and the soft lips... Your semblance looks strikingly similar to hers.
say:7:1910842006:1.source_cn: 你的脸也经过伪饰，但我可以看破它们，明亮的眼睛与柔软的...

say:7:1910842006:1.female: Your face is disguised too, but I can see through such things. The bright eyes and the soft lips... Your semblance looks strikingly similar to hers.

say:8:1910842007:1.text: How wonderful! Is she well? Did her wish come true? Wait, is she still always frowning off into her thoughts the way she used to?
say:8:1910842007:1.source_cn: 啊，我真高兴！我的妹妹，她还好吗？她夙愿已偿，还像以前...

say:8:1910842007:1.female: How wonderful! Is she well? Did her wish come true? Wait, is she still always frowning off into her thoughts the way she used to?

say:9:1910842008:1.male: Wait, why didn't she come with you?
say:9:1910842008:1.female: Wait, why didn't she come with you?

choice_prompt:10:1910842008.text: Wait, why didn't she come with you?

choice_prompt:10:1910842008.female: Wait, why didn't she come with you?

say:11:1910842009:1.source_cn: 她为什么要设下封印？流光海里没有堕落的神明，也没有前往...
say:11:1910842009:1.male: Why would she leave a seal? There are no fallen gods in the Shimmering Sea... no gateway to the Tree of Life...

choice:10:0:1.male: I came looking for the seal she left behind.
choice:10:0:1.female: I came looking for the seal she left behind.

choice:10:1:2.text: Even the God of Death doesn't know where she went.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 她消失了，连死神都不知道她的去向
choice:10:1:2.male: Even the God of Death doesn't know where she went.
choice:10:1:2.female: Even the God of Death doesn't know where she went.

say:13:1910842011:1.text: Oh, my sister... she's gone, isn't she?
say:13:1910842011:1.source_cn: 哦……我的妹妹，她不在了，是吗？
say:13:1910842011:1.male: Oh, my sister... she's gone, isn't she?
say:13:1910842011:1.female: Oh, my sister... she's gone, isn't she?

say:14:1910842012:1.text: She used the power of life, and so fate came for her.
say:14:1910842012:1.source_cn: 她实行了生命的权柄，所以命运找上了她。
say:14:1910842012:1.male: She used the power of life, and so fate came for her.
say:14:1910842012:1.female: She used the power of life, and so fate came for her.

say:15:1910842013:1.text: Yet here you are, bearing her mark and keeping her old name. That means she never gave up... not until the very end.
say:15:1910842013:1.source_cn: 可你还站在这里，带着她的印记，保留着她的旧名，那就说明...
say:15:1910842013:1.male: Yet here you are, bearing her mark and keeping her old name. That means she never gave up... not until the very end.
say:15:1910842013:1.female: Yet here you are, bearing her mark and keeping her old name. That means she never gave up... not until the very end.

say:16:1910842014:1.text: You are the one she placed her trust in, so you are my guest... my family. I will tell you everything, child of Dura. I will hide nothing from you.
say:16:1910842014:1.source_cn: 你是她托付的人，就是我的客人、我的亲人。我会告诉你一切...
say:16:1910842014:1.male: You are the one she placed her trust in, so you are my guest... my family. I will tell you everything, child of Dura. I will hide nothing from you.
say:16:1910842014:1.female: You are the one she placed her trust in, so you are my guest... my family. I will tell you everything, child of Dura. I will hide nothing from you.

narration:17:1910842015:1.female: As she speaks, she reaches out her hand.

narration:18:1910842016:1.male: Cold fingertips press against your forehead.
narration:18:1910842016:1.female: Cold fingertips press against your forehead.

say:19:1910842017:1.text: Countless memories come flooding in. The pact between Oceana and Dura. The truth of the Merfolk's birth and destruction. The plea of the Graveborn Nerion...
say:19:1910842017:1.source_cn: 无数记忆涌来，奥汐娜与艾雅的约定，海裔诞生和毁灭的真相...
say:19:1910842017:1.male: Countless memories come flooding in. The pact between Oceana and Dura. The truth of the Merfolk's birth and destruction. The plea of the Graveborn Nerion...
say:19:1910842017:1.female: Countless memories come flooding in. The pact between Oceana and Dura. The truth of the Merfolk's birth and destruction. The plea of the Graveborn Nerion...

say:20:1910842018:1.text: ...and what Oceana is about to do.
say:20:1910842018:1.source_cn: 以及奥汐娜将要做的事。
say:20:1910842018:1.male: ...and what Oceana is about to do.
say:20:1910842018:1.female: ...and what Oceana is about to do.

say:21:1910842019:1.text: This is the truth of my existence. The truth of every Merfolk's existence.
say:21:1910842019:1.source_cn: 这就是我存在的真相，也是所有海裔存在的真相。
say:21:1910842019:1.male: This is the truth of my existence. The truth of every Merfolk's existence.
say:21:1910842019:1.female: This is the truth of my existence. The truth of every Merfolk's existence.

say:22:1910842020:1.text: They are me, and I am them. Every cycle and every gathering is how I awaken.
say:22:1910842020:1.source_cn: 他们是我，我是他们。每一次循环，每一次聚合，都是我重新...
say:22:1910842020:1.male: They are me, and I am them. Every cycle and every gathering is how I awaken.
say:22:1910842020:1.female: They are me, and I am them. Every cycle and every gathering is how I awaken.

say:23:1910842021:1.text: Dura knew all of it. She understood me. I cannot allow myself to become a thing she would have to kill, like how she killed the other gods. I don't want to be one more scar in her memory.
say:23:1910842021:1.source_cn: 艾雅知道这一切，她理解我，我不能允许自己变成她必须杀死...
say:23:1910842021:1.male: Dura knew all of it. She understood me. I cannot allow myself to become a thing she would have to kill, like how she killed the other gods. I don't want to be one more scar in her memory.
say:23:1910842021:1.female: Dura knew all of it. She understood me. I cannot allow myself to become a thing she would have to kill, like how she killed the other gods. I don't want to be one more scar in her memory.

say:24:1910842022:1.text: So this is all I can do. Awaken and scatter myself once more.
say:24:1910842022:1.source_cn: 所以我只能这么做……复苏，然后再度分散。
say:24:1910842022:1.male: So this is all I can do. Awaken and scatter myself once more.
say:24:1910842022:1.female: So this is all I can do. Awaken and scatter myself once more.

choice_prompt:25:1910842022.text: So this is all I can do. Awaken and scatter myself once more.

choice_prompt:25:1910842022.female: So this is all I can do. Awaken and scatter myself once more.

say:26:1910842023:1.source_cn: 复苏是我避免神堕的唯一方式，我不能、也不敢停下。

say:26:1910842023:1.female: Awakening is the only way I have to avoid the fall from grace. I cannot stop.

say:27:1910842024:1.text: If I fell, I would become Dura's enemy. I would rather vanish than ever stand against her.
say:27:1910842024:1.source_cn: 如果我堕落了，就会成为艾雅的敌人——我宁愿消失，也不愿...
say:27:1910842024:1.male: If I fell, I would become Dura's enemy. I would rather vanish than ever stand against her.
say:27:1910842024:1.female: If I fell, I would become Dura's enemy. I would rather vanish than ever stand against her.

say:28:1910842025:1.text: You truly are not her. You have a face like hers, but none of her strength.
say:28:1910842025:1.source_cn: 你果然不是她，你有与她相似的面容，却缺乏与她同等的力量。
say:28:1910842025:1.male: You truly are not her. You have a face like hers, but none of her strength.
say:28:1910842025:1.female: You truly are not her. You have a face like hers, but none of her strength.

choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 陆地将面临海啸，我没法保护他们！
choice:25:0:1.male: There will be a tsunami on land! I can't protect them!
choice:25:0:1.female: There will be a tsunami on land! I can't protect them!

say:29:1910842026:1.text: You offer the same answer Dura did. Descension... but if I am no longer a god, am I still me?
say:29:1910842026:1.source_cn: 降格……你提出了和艾雅一样的解法，但如果不再是神，我还...
say:29:1910842026:1.male: You offer the same answer Dura did. Descension... but if I am no longer a god, am I still me?
say:29:1910842026:1.female: You offer the same answer Dura did. Descension... but if I am no longer a god, am I still me?

say:30:1910842027:1.text: Dura and I made a promise to help each other find the true way. I cannot break it. I cannot simply give up on my own while she is gone.
say:30:1910842027:1.source_cn: 我和艾雅约好了，要帮助她找到真正的办法。我不能失约，我...
say:30:1910842027:1.male: Dura and I made a promise to help each other find the true way. I cannot break it. I cannot simply give up on my own while she is gone.
say:30:1910842027:1.female: Dura and I made a promise to help each other find the true way. I cannot break it. I cannot simply give up on my own while she is gone.

say:32:1910842029:1.text: I'm sorry, child of Dura. Even if it is your wish, I cannot grant it.
say:32:1910842029:1.source_cn: 所以，对不起，艾雅的孩子，即便这是你的愿望，我也无法替...

say:32:1910842029:1.female: I'm sorry, child of Dura. Even if it is your wish, I cannot grant it.

choice:25:1:2.text: Descension is an option. Give up your godhood. End the cycle.
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 纡尊降格，终止循环吧，那也是一种方法！
choice:25:1:2.male: Descension is an option. Give up your godhood. End the cycle.
choice:25:1:2.female: Descension is an option. Give up your godhood. End the cycle.

choice:50:1:2.source_cn: 艾菲拉，你不是神明的碎片，而是我的朋友！
